_readme: The claims ledger: every published claim that has been retracted,
corrected or scope-limited, and every surface that carries it.
The rule this file exists to enforce: A RETRACTION IS NOT COMPLETE UNTIL
ITS SEARCH TERMS ARE RECORDED. integrity/claim_propagation.py refuses to
pass a claim whose state is retracted, corrected or scope-limited and
whose search_phrasings list is empty. Recording the phrasing is what
makes the retraction mechanically enforceable on every future surface,
including surfaces that do not exist yet.
Field notes:
state             retracted    the claim is withdrawn; the old form is wrong
corrected    a specific form is wrong, a nearby form is right
scope-limited the measurement stands, the generalisation does not
search_phrasings  regexes, each with a note saying what it is looking for.
Case-insensitive. Written tight: a phrasing that fires on
ordinary prose gets the whole check ignored.
requires_near     scope-limited only. A hit is acceptable if one of these
matches inside the context window; otherwise it is flagged.
exempt_paths      surfaces that carry the superseded wording ON PURPOSE
(verbatim archives, the retraction record itself).
carried_by        every local surface known to carry this claim, and what
state that surface is in. Checked for existence.
remote_surfaces   upstream comments and third-party guides. A checker
cannot edit or (by default) read these; they are printed

correction_anchors  distinctive strings that say a nearby correction is about THIS claim. Required for retracted and corrected states. Keep them DISTINCTIVE: 'qwen' in a Qwen-heavy repo let an unrelated PR-10 correction 30 lines away vouch for the uncorrected Qwen dose-depth paragraph during this file's own bring-up.
as MANUAL every run so they cannot be forgotten.

context_window._note: Lines around a hit searched for a correction marker. This project's convention is to leave the superseded sentence visible and put the correction immediately after it, so the window is asymmetric. Measured on the tree as it stands, the widest legitimate gap is 7 lines; 20 is generous. Wider windows let an unrelated correction vouch for a claim, which is why correction_anchors exist as well.

claims.superseded_by: Depth among fired turns is statistically flat across bare / +identity / +neutral / +tools / +identity+tools (all pairwise p >= 0.13; the tools arm was the highest median). claims.title: Laguna streams reasoning as delta.reasoning, not delta.reasoning_content
claims.superseded_by: The field name is a property of the serving stack, not of the checkpoint, and the read side and the write side can disagree on the same runtime. MTPLX emits reasoning_content on its MLX lane; on llama.cpp only reasoning_content reaches the template on history replay. Read both names, write whichever the runtime accepts.

claims.title: The apparatus costs no answering ability (trap 42 capability reading)
claims.superseded_by: All three statements generalise a conditional accuracy computed on the 386 samples that attempted an answer into a claim about all 492. The 106 routed samples were selected by the model's own behaviour and their correctness was never observed. What survives: the drop is routing-dominated, accuracy among attempting samples was flat, and the routed cases are unmeasured.

claims.title: The cold-versus-warm cache separation was ten against ten with no exceptions
claims.superseded_by: Ten requests carry per-request prefix-cache counters, not twenty. Four at 79.44% coverage or below, all with finish_reason length; six at 99.81% or above, all with stop. The separation is four against six. Recovery of the planted fact on the low-cache arm was 1 of 4, not zero, and 524,281 is an explicit counterexample where the cold run surfaced the passphrase and then failed to stop. The original aggregation pooled six ladder runs and four framing runs whose cache fractions were never measured, and placed one arm in the high-cache group when its own TTFT says it prefilled cold. The direction of the finding is unchanged; its n is smaller and it now carries a counterexample.
